4:122.text: But the ones who believe and do righteous deeds - We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever.

4:124.text: And whoever does righteous deeds, whether male or female, while being a believer - those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged,
the speck on a date seed.

4:125.text: And who is better in religion than one who submits himself to Allāh while being a doer of good and follows the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth? And Allāh took Abraham as an intimate friend.

4:126.text: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allāh, of all things, encompassing.

4:127.text: ruling concerning women. Say, "Allāh gives you a ruling about them and

in justice." And whatever you do of good - indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing of it.
